title: 一詞多義 (Polysemy) 練習

senses.zh: 拿；攜帶（把物品帶往某處）

senses.sourceMeaning: Travel by a particular form of transport
Need a certain amount of time

senses.zh: 接受；收下（別人給的東西）

senses.sourceMeaning: To go with someone and bring or lead them to a particular place.

questions.en: Please take this document to the manager.
questions.zh: 請把這份文件拿給經理。

questions.en: I take the bus to work every morning.
questions.zh: 我每天早上都搭巴士上班。
questions.zhMasked: 我每天早上都____巴士上班。

questions.en: It takes about 30 minutes to get there.
questions.zh: 到那裡大約需要 30 分鐘。

questions.en: She took the gift and thanked him.
questions.zh: 她收下了禮物，並向他道謝。

questions.en: You should take this medicine twice a day.
questions.zh: 你應該每天服用這種藥兩次。
questions.zhMasked: 你應該每天____這種藥兩次。

questions.en: Someone took my umbrella by mistake.
questions.zh: 有人不小心拿走了我的雨傘。
questions.zhMasked: 有人不小心____了我的雨傘。

questions.en: I’ll take the blue one.
questions.zh: 我要選藍色的那個。

questions.en: Could you take a photo of us?
questions.zh: 你可以幫我們拍一張照片嗎？
questions.zhMasked: 你可以幫我們____一張照片嗎？

questions.en: I can take you to the reception desk.
questions.zh: 我可以帶您到接待處。

questions.en: I can take you to the 23rd floor.
questions.zh: 我可以帶您到 23 樓。

senses.zh: 更接近（事實或準確答案）

questions.en: This station is closer to my office.
questions.zh: 這個車站離我的辦公室比較近。
questions.zhMasked: 這個車站離我的辦公室____。

questions.zh: 隨著我們越來越接近截止日期，大家都變得更忙。
questions.zhMasked: 隨著我們越來越____截止日期，大家都變得更忙。

questions.en: We became closer after working together.
questions.zh: 我們一起工作之後，關係變得更親近了。
questions.zhMasked: 我們一起工作之後，關係變得____了。

questions.en: Your second answer is closer to the truth.
questions.zh: 你的第二個答案更接近事實。

questions.en: Yes. Can I use these lifts here? They are closer.
questions.zh: 可以。我可以使用這邊的升降機嗎？它們比較近。
questions.zhMasked: 可以。我可以使用這邊的升降機嗎？它們____。

questions.en: These are not the right lifts for the 23rd floor.
questions.zh: 這些不是前往 23 樓的正確升降機。
questions.zhMasked: 這些不是前往 23 樓的____升降機。

questions.en: Please take Lift H on the right.
questions.zh: 請乘搭右邊的 H 號升降機。
questions.zhMasked: 請乘搭____的 H 號升降機。

questions.en: You did the right thing.
questions.zh: 你做了正確的事。
questions.context: 對方誠實承認錯誤，並把拾到的錢包交還失主。

questions.en: Everyone has the right to speak freely.
questions.zh: 每個人都有自由發言的權利。
questions.zhMasked: 每個人都有自由發言的____。

questions.en: The bus stop is right outside the building.
questions.zh: 巴士站就在大樓外面。

questions.en: I’m afraid these are not the right lifts for the 23rd floor.
questions.zh: 恐怕這些不是前往 23 樓的正確升降機。
questions.zhMasked: 恐怕這些不是前往 23 樓的____升降機。

senses.sourceMeaning: Make something clear or prove something

questions.en: Can you show me your ID?
questions.zh: 你可以給我看你的身分證嗎？
questions.zhMasked: 你可以把你的身分證____嗎？

questions.en: I’ll show you to the meeting room.
questions.zh: 我會帶您到會議室。

questions.en: The results show that sales have increased.
questions.zh: 結果顯示銷售額有所增加。

questions.en: She showed great patience.
questions.zh: 她展現出極大的耐性。

questions.en: We watched a comedy show last night.
questions.zh: 我們昨晚看了一個喜劇節目。
questions.zhMasked: 我們昨晚看了一個喜劇____。

questions.zhMasked: 沒問題。我會____您去正確的升降機區域。

senses.zh: 憑證；回條（收件或登記證明）

questions.en: Please keep your receipt in case you need a refund.
questions.zh: 請保留您的收據，以防之後需要退款。
questions.zhMasked: 請保留您的____，以防之後需要退款。

questions.en: You will receive an email receipt after submitting the form.
questions.zh: 提交表格後，您會收到一封電子收件確認。
questions.zhMasked: 提交表格後，您會收到一封電子____。

questions.en: Payment is due within seven days of receipt of the invoice.
questions.zh: 收到發票後七天內須付款。

questions.en: Ticket receipts increased this year.
questions.zh: 今年的門票收入增加了。

questions.en: Thanks. What is this QR receipt for?
questions.zh: 謝謝。這張 QR 憑證是做甚麼用的？
questions.zhMasked: 謝謝。這張 QR ____是做甚麼用的？

senses.sourceMeaning: Prevent someone or something from doing something
Take care of or maintain something

questions.en: You can keep the receipt.
questions.zh: 你可以保留這張收據。

questions.en: Please keep walking straight.
questions.zh: 請繼續直走。

questions.en: Please keep the door closed.
questions.zh: 請保持門關著。

questions.en: We keep the important documents in this cabinet.
questions.zh: 我們把重要文件存放在這個櫃子裡。
questions.zhMasked: 我們把重要文件____在這個櫃子裡。

questions.en: The heavy rain kept us from leaving.
questions.zh: 大雨令我們無法離開。

questions.en: They keep chickens on their farm.
questions.zh: 他們在農場飼養雞隻。

questions.en: Please keep the QR receipt with you.
questions.zh: 請保留這張 QR 憑證並隨身攜帶。
questions.zhMasked: 請把這張 QR 憑證____。

senses.sourceMeaning: Help or provide a service to people
Go to or cover a place

questions.en: This restaurant serves breakfast until 11 a.m.
questions.zh: 這間餐廳早餐供應至上午 11 點。
questions.zhMasked: 這間餐廳早餐____至上午 11 點。

questions.en: This office serves more than 500 customers every day.
questions.zh: 這間辦公室每天服務超過 500 名顧客。
questions.zhMasked: 這間辦公室每天____超過 500 名顧客。

questions.en: This train serves all stations between Central and the airport.
questions.zh: 這班列車停靠中環至機場之間的所有車站。
questions.zhMasked: 這班列車____中環至機場之間的所有車站。

questions.en: He served in the army for ten years.
questions.zh: 他在軍隊服役了十年。

questions.en: This room can serve as a meeting room.
questions.zh: 這個房間可以用作會議室。

questions.en: He was served with legal papers.
questions.zh: 他收到了正式送達的法律文件。

questions.en: Those lifts do not serve the 23rd floor.
questions.zh: 那些升降機不到 23 樓。

senses.sourceMeaning: The ability or right to enter or use something

senses.zh: 使用機會；取得途徑（資源）
senses.sourceMeaning: The ability to obtain a service or resource
Reach a system, file, or device

questions.en: You can access the building through the main entrance.
questions.zh: 你可以經由正門進入這棟大樓。
questions.zhMasked: 你可以經由正門____這棟大樓。

questions.en: You can access your account online.
questions.zh: 你可以在網上存取你的帳戶。
questions.zhMasked: 你可以在網上____你的帳戶。

questions.en: Only staff have access to this room.
questions.zh: 只有員工有權進入這個房間。

questions.en: Students have free access to the library.
questions.zh: 學生可以免費使用圖書館。

questions.en: I can’t access the file.
questions.zh: 我無法開啟／存取這個檔案。

questions.en: Please use Lift H on your right to access the 23rd floor.
questions.zh: 請使用您右邊的 H 號升降機前往 23 樓。
questions.zhMasked: 請使用您右邊的 H 號升降機____ 23 樓。

senses.sourceMeaning: Happen or exist together with something

questions.zh: 她陪我去醫院。

questions.en: The heavy rain was accompanied by strong winds.
questions.zh: 大雨伴隨著強風。

questions.en: The application must be accompanied by a copy of your ID.
questions.zh: 申請表必須附上您的身分證副本。
questions.zhMasked: 申請表必須____您的身分證副本。

questions.en: She sang while he accompanied her on the piano.
questions.zh: 她唱歌時，他用鋼琴為她伴奏。
questions.zhMasked: 她唱歌時，他用鋼琴為她____。

questions.en: No problem at all. I’ll accompany you to the correct lift bank.
questions.zh: 完全沒問題。我會陪同您前往正確的升降機區域。
questions.zhMasked: 完全沒問題。我會____您前往正確的升降機區域。

senses.zh: 安全的；受保護或受管制的（狀態）
確保安全；保護（採取措施）

questions.en: Your personal information is secure.
questions.zh: 您的個人資料是安全並受到保護的。

questions.en: Please secure the door before you leave.
questions.zh: 離開前請把門鎖好。

questions.en: Please secure your luggage before the journey.
questions.zh: 出發前請把行李固定好。

questions.en: She secured a job at an international company.
questions.zh: 她成功獲得了一份國際公司的工作。
questions.zhMasked: 她____了一份國際公司的工作。

questions.en: The agreement will secure funding for the project.
questions.zh: 這項協議將確保這個專案獲得資金。
questions.zhMasked: 這項協議將____這個專案獲得資金。

questions.en: When you leave, scan the QR code at the exit gate on G/F to leave the secured area.
questions.zh: 當您離開時，請在地下樓層的出口閘機掃描 QR code，以離開受管制區域。
questions.zhMasked: 當您離開時，請在地下樓層的出口閘機掃描 QR code，以離開____區域。

questions.en: Reading is one of my greatest pleasures.
questions.zh: 閱讀是我最大的樂趣之一。

questions.en: It would be my pleasure to help.
questions.zh: 我很樂意幫忙。

questions.en: He travels for both business and pleasure.
questions.zh: 他旅行既是為了公事，也是為了休閒享受。
questions.zhMasked: 他旅行既是為了公事，也是為了____。

questions.en: My pleasure. Enjoy your visit.
questions.zh: 不客氣／我的榮幸。祝您到訪愉快。

questions.en: Please close the door.

questions.en: I want to close my bank account.

questions.en: They closed the deal yesterday.
questions.zh: 他們昨天成功完成了這筆交易。

questions.zh: 公司正努力縮小成本與收入之間的差距。
questions.zhMasked: 公司正努力____成本與收入之間的差距。

questions.en: Thank you. The office normally closes at 6:00 p.m.
questions.zh: 謝謝。辦公室通常在下午 6 點關門。
questions.zhMasked: 謝謝。辦公室通常在下午 6 點____。

senses.zh: 派；安排或准許某人前往

senses.sourceMeaning: Take someone somewhere, especially for treatment or help
Cause someone to enter a state

questions.zh: 我今天下午會寄／發一封電郵給你。
questions.zhMasked: 我今天下午會____一封電郵給你。

questions.zhMasked: 她從日本____了一份禮物給我。

questions.en: The manager sent him to the reception desk.
questions.zh: 經理叫他去／派他去接待處。

questions.en: They sent him to the hospital.
questions.zh: 他們把他送往醫院。

questions.en: The impact sent the box across the floor.
questions.zh: 撞擊令箱子滑到了地板另一邊。
questions.zhMasked: 撞擊____箱子到了地板另一邊。

sourceNotes.note: The PDF passage uses the guiding-someone sense, which is absent from its table. That source meaning is included as take-8 with one supplementary example: “I can take you to the reception desk.” All eight supplied table examples are preserved.

The source passage uses right twice with two different senses. The final question uses the complete first sentence as the original excerpt, testing correct/suitable. The source table example preserves the right-hand-side use.

sourceNotes: access-example-4 accepts both data access and file-opening senses because the original sentence supports both. A moral context cue clarifies right-example-2 without changing its source sentence.
